description: Composes the SECTIONS of the Italian INTRASTAT summary listing from transaction lines, assigning each line to the right section (INTRA-1bis sales of goods, 1ter corrections, 1quater services rendered, 1quinquies corrections, 1sexies call-off stock; INTRA-2bis purchases of goods, 2ter, 2quater services received, 2quinquies) and VALIDATING them: allowed Member State (Northern Ireland XI only for GOODS; San Marino and the United Kingdom are out of scope), counterparty VAT number (format per Member State + checksum for Italian ones), 8-digit combined nomenclature (or the simplified code 99500000), format of the nature of transaction and required fields per section. Returns the populated sections, the totals, the deadline and a text summary for review. ⚠️ It does NOT generate the ELECTRONIC file for the customs telematic service (Intr@Web / ADM): the official record layout cannot be reproduced from a verifiable public source, so it was not invented. What you get is a data structure + summary, to be transferred to the official channel. No silent defaults: a missing required field produces an explicit error, never an arbitrary fill-in. VAT numbers are validated OFFLINE (format and checksum): for the live VIES check of the counterparty use `verify_payee`. Determine the frequency first with `intrastat_periodicity`. Indicative, it does not replace the accountant or customs broker. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

anno.description: Year of the reference period (the current forms apply from 2022).

mese.description: Month of the reference period (1–12). With quarterly frequency it identifies the quarter.

partita_iva_dichiarante.description: Italian VAT number of the filer (11 digits, optional). If provided it is validated with the checksum.

periodicita.description: Filing frequency of the listing — determine it with `intrastat_periodicity`. With 'nessun_obbligo' the call is REJECTED with an explanation: below the threshold the listing is not filed.

righe.description: Transaction lines to summarise. Maximum 25 on the anonymous surface (the authenticated API has no such limit). Lines of different flows/categories can coexist: each ends up in its own section.

ammontare.description: Amount of the transactions in EURO. Negative allowed only if rettifica=true.

anno_riferimento_rettifica.description: Required if rettifica=true: year of the corrected period.

call_off_stock.description: Sales of GOODS only: call-off stock regime (art. 17-bis Dir. 2006/112/EC) → section INTRA-1sexies.

categoria.description: Decides which fields are required: GOODS (beni) fields and SERVICES (servizi) fields are mutually exclusive.

codice_servizio.description: SERVICES only: 6-digit CPA code. The format is validated, not its existence in the CPA table.

massa_netta_kg.description: GOODS only: net mass in kg.

modalita_incasso.description: SERVICES only: 'B' bank transfer · 'A' credit · 'X' other.

natura_transazione.description: GOODS only: nature of transaction code — 1 digit (column A) or 2 digits (columns A+B, required above €20,000,000 of trade in the previous year). ONLY the format is validated: the code descriptions are Annex XI to Det. ADM 493869/RU/2021, not reproducible from a verifiable text source, and are not invented.

nomenclatura_combinata.description: GOODS only: 8-digit CN code. For consignments worth less than €1,000 the single code 99500000 is allowed. The FORMAT is validated, not its existence in the year's CN (the CN table is annual and not in the repository).

paese_controparte.description: ISO2 code of the counterparty's Member State (e.g. DE, FR, ES; EL for Greece, not GR). 'XI' (Northern Ireland) is allowed ONLY for goods. SM (San Marino) and GB are out of scope and rejected.

paese_destinazione.description: GOODS only: country of destination/provenance of the goods (ISO2).

paese_origine.description: GOODS only: country of origin of the goods (ISO2).

partita_iva_controparte.description: Counterparty VAT number, with or without country prefix (e.g. DE123456789 or 123456789). Validated against the Member State format; Italian ones also with the checksum. No VIES query.

rettifica.description: True if the line corrects a PREVIOUS period → ter/quinquies sections. Requires `anno_riferimento_rettifica`. Only corrections may have a negative amount.

riferimento.description: Free reference (e.g. invoice number). Only for your own traceability: it is not part of the listing.

title: INTRASTAT: compose and validate sections
